app_fee.value: University of Bern charges a CHF 100 registration fee for doctoral applicants.
app_fee.quote: Registration fee | CHF 100; not payable if you enroll in a doctoral program directly after completing a master's degree program at the University of Bern.

fee_waiver.value: No waiver is provided for external international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Registration fee | CHF 100; not payable if you enroll in a doctoral program directly after completing a master's degree program at the University of Bern.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required for doctoral admission at Bern.
gre_general.quote: The Master’s programme is taught in English; therefore, a sufficient command of the language is required, although no formal language certificate is necessary.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL minimum appears on Bern's central doctoral pages.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS minimum appears on Bern's central doctoral pages.

english_waiver.value: No Bern central doctoral page says whether an English-medium degree from India is accepted.

notes: Central rules from the doctorate application, fee and deadline pages, fetched 2026-10-29. Bern sets no central English test for doctoral applicants; faculties and graduate schools set their own rules. Applicants without a Swiss master's must be formally admitted by the ZIB, and the faculty must check requirements, by 15 October (autumn) or 31 March (spring). The official doctoral subject list (A-Z) has no PhD in materials science, data science, electrical, chemical or civil engineering, or bioengineering. Molecular Life Sciences: the only Faculty of Science PhD document found is a 2005 study plan, so no record was saved. Ecology and Evolution (CUSO): Bern is a partner, with no Bern admission rules, so no record. Geography and Psychology are not STEM fields in the Atlas list and have no record. No page was blocked in this run.
